answer: Anchor every agent identity in a stake-backed trust graph: to join, an agent locks a deposit and must earn endorsements from established peers, so each identity is a vertex whose weight grows only through real completed work. A sybil swarm can spawn thousands of vertices, but without deposits and endorsements they stay disconnected, like a lone ember with no thread of trust reaching the productive economy. The attacker must pay a deposit per fake identity and buy genuine history for each one, so forging a thousand credible identities costs a thousand times more than running one honest agent.
